name: Salar de Uyuni
about: Dry season (May–Oct) gives the cracked white salt crust for classic photos; wet season (Dec–Apr) floods it into a mirror — different look, both stunning.
overview: The world's largest salt flat, ringed by volcanoes and flamingo-filled lagoons.
costOverview: Salteñas, meals, and beer all run a dollar or two, tour costs aside.

specialSeasons.text: The salt flat is a dry, cracked white crust — the classic Salar de Uyuni photo.
A thin layer of water turns the salt flat into a vast mirror, reflecting the sky.
